description: This file is a Perl script designed to parse build target information from makefiles within a specific directory structure. It retrieves details about target architectures, kernels, devices, and subtargets, and outputs this information based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information from makefile outputs to populate target, architecture, and kernel data structures.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device profile information from makefile outputs to populate device data structures.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Aggregates target information by scanning target directories and invoking parsing functions.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Fetches device data for a specific target/subtarget by invoking parse_devices.
